calibration.arrival_rate_limit: RATE is capped at 200 requests/s only for constant-arrival-rate; shared-iterations is a finite burst with no rate cap
calibration.sample_window: 2s warm-up excluded from deltas, 8s formal sample, up to 3s graceful stop
calibration.limits: 25 max VUs, 200 target requests/s, 3s request timeout
calibration.p99: under 1000 requests per round is marked limited_sample; tail differences are not treated as stable improvements
